title: SG-1.4 · Compact header overlay wired to the UI store with Tailwind layout tests
summary: Add the compact header overlay and align layout tests with the Tailwind layout
description: Context: GameLayout is already Tailwind-based and useUiStore holds soundEnabled and settingsOpen, but App renders a bare RoundBadge and Countdown inside the scene and shows 'Round unavailable' when the API fails, with no explanation. Desired behavior: a compact header overlay shows logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings, wired to useUiStore, with loading and error states. Expected result: header is visible over the scene and tests/layout.test.tsx asserts Tailwind classes instead of legacy CSS strings. Why: the goal requires a polished header and honest round-status feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Given a loaded round, when the header renders, then logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings are visible
Given the round request is pending or failed, when the header renders, then a loading or an explained error message is shown instead of 'Round unavailable'
Given the sound toggle or settings button is clicked, when the store is read, then soundEnabled or settingsOpen has flipped
Given tests/layout.test.tsx runs, when it asserts layout, then it checks Tailwind classes and not legacy CSS strings

in_scope: App round loading/error state and header wiring
preserve: RoundBadge and Countdown public behavior and their tests

technical_constraints: React + TypeScript, Tailwind, Lucide icons, Zustand
Use real getCurrentRound API, no mock data in product code
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered with passing unit tests
non_functional: Header must not cause horizontal overflow on mobile
